campaign_name: OrgX Twitter Ads Discovery Sprint (Q1 2026) - Iteration 2
objective: By 2026-03-31, validate one repeatable Twitter/X paid acquisition path that yields >= 45 qualified trials at <= $115 CAC and >= 14% trial-to-activation rate.

target_audience.primary_icp: Technical founders and engineering managers operating multi-agent workflows who need clear execution state, decision routing, and reliable handoff continuity.
pain_points: Execution state is fragmented across terminals and chat threads.
Approval blockers are detected too late, stalling delivery windows.
Agent handoffs lose context and create rework.
Teams need trustworthy progress telemetry during API instability.

messaging_pillars.pillar: Operate all agent workstreams from one control plane
proof_points: Mission Control centralizes initiatives, workstreams, milestones, and tasks.
Live activity stream gives run-by-run execution visibility.
Decision queue surfaces approval prompts with urgency and status.
Next-up queue highlights highest-leverage execution steps.
Outbox buffering preserves events when upstream APIs degrade.
Replay and snapshot merge keep operators informed after reconnect.

success_metrics.metric: Qualified trials attributed to Twitter/X ads

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pain-led copy centered on stalled execution will outperform feature-led copy by >= 25% CTR.
Follower-lookalike targeting of agent-tooling audiences will cut CAC by >= 15% versus broad keyword targeting.
Retargeting onboarding starters with social-proof creative will increase activation rate by >= 2.5 percentage points.

audiences: Follower lookalikes for AI agent infrastructure and developer workflow accounts
Keyword intent cluster: agent orchestration, multi-agent operations, MCP workflows
Interest stack: engineering leadership, dev tooling buyers, AI ops practitioners
creative_matrix: Variant A: dashboard screenshot + blocker-time hook
Variant B: workflow GIF + continuity proof
Variant C: execution KPI stat card + CTA
tracking_requirements: UTM taxonomy includes campaign, audience, creative, and placement
Post-click events: landing visit, onboarding start, workspace connected, first run created
Weekly cohort readout across CAC, activation, and blocker-resolution proxy metrics

assumptions: Destination flow can reliably track onboarding start, workspace connect, and first run creation events.
Creative production support is available for one static image set and one short GIF set this week.
No legal or policy constraints block technical claims used in ad copy.
